item.summary: The Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD), Government of India, in collaboration with the Rajasthan Skill and Livelihoods Development Corporation (RSLDC), organised a Captive Employer CXO Meet under Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY) 2.0 at the Rajasthan International Centre (RIC), Jaipur, today.
item.title: From Skilling to Sustainable Employment: Captive Employer CXO Meet to mobilise industry partners to the DDU-GKY 2.0 held at Jaipur
